name: shipkit
description: The project knowledge layer for Claude Code — a verified PROJECT_MAP.md per project, elder agents (grandfather/eve/archivist) that answer from their own context, a cross-project registry, spec-driven development with decision records, composable stack overlays, and a session hook that injects the always-on rules and nudges on drift. Run /shipkit:setup to install the rules as files and tailor to your stack.
